# My Visit Prep (Vaani)

> My Visit Prep is a free tool that helps patients prepare better questions before doctor appointments. Users describe their symptoms and health concerns in plain language, and the app uses AI to generate a focused, prioritized list of questions to bring to their visit. Users can also upload a lab report or medical document to get clarifying questions about their results. It works without an account; all notes stay on your device.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): Enter symptoms or concerns and generate a personalized question list for your next doctor visit.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How the app handles your health information.

## Localized versions

The app is available in 17 languages. Each language has its own URL prefix:

- English (default): /
- Spanish: /es/
- Hindi: /hi/
- Vietnamese: /vi/
- Chinese: /zh/
- Tamil: /ta/
- Kannada: /kn/
- French: /fr/
- Portuguese: /pt/
- Filipino: /tl/
- Japanese: /ja/
- Korean: /ko/
- Thai: /th/
- Indonesian: /id/
- Bengali: /bn/
- Urdu: /ur/
- Telugu: /te/
- Malayalam: /ml/

## Intended audience

Patients preparing for a medical appointment who want to make the most of limited time with their doctor.

## Notes

- No account or login is required.
- Health descriptions and uploaded reports are processed transiently and are not stored.
- The companion mobile app (Vaani) offers the same functionality on iOS.
- Vaani is an educational preparation tool. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
